title: Managed Database: primary per-node reconciliation — assessment outcome
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database primary per-node reconciliation uses the following assessment outcome basis. Convert reconciled aggregate node-hours to an integer count of hundredths. With a positive topology count, multiply those hundredths by ten thousand to express millionths, divide by the topology count with exact integer quotient/remainder arithmetic, and round a half or larger remainder upward. Store the consequent integer millionths divided by one million as the six-decimal per-node average; zero topology returns zero and is not eligible for processing.

## Hypothetical calculation
Hypothetical inputs: aggregate usage is 1.00 node-hour across 3 nodes. The aggregate is 100 hundredths, or 1000000 millionths. Integer division by 3 gives 333333 with remainder 1; the remainder is below half the divisor. The recorded average is 0.333333 node-hour. For a hypothetical 0.01 node-hour across 32 nodes, the exact 312.5 millionths rounds upward to 313 millionths, giving 0.000313 node-hour.
